items.answer:
Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month, which totals 18.0 days across a full plan year.

Next steps:
- Check your MosaicOne balance
- Review accrual posting dates

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team to ensure the team's onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne rather than week by week, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem. Weeks containing a company holiday, approved PTO or approved travel reduce the requirement proportionally.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager
- Check MosaicOne for your rolling four-week average

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; employees may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one
- Check MosaicOne for your coverage start date

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for sensitive data like a bulk personal-data extract over email alone. Genuine internal requests for payroll changes, payment redirections or bulk personal-data extracts are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Recommendation — not company policy: Learn to recognize phishing signals: urgency mismatched to the sender's usual tone, requests to move conversations to personal channels, links where displayed text differs from destination, requests for credentials or security approvals, unexpected attachments, and out-of-the-blue approaches from senior people.

Next steps:
- Forward to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply or act

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories, including items such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and small filing cabinet.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claims before plan year end
- Confirm manager approval if onsite

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent. The 16 weeks are the same whether the employee gave birth, did not give birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement leading to adoption.

Next steps:
- Confirm your eligibility after 6 months of service
- Coordinate timing with your manager

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering room rate only. Local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the standard cap cannot be met—a remote field site with one hotel or a sold-out market—the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed.

Next steps:
- Check MosaicOne Travel for your destination's cap
- Book through MosaicOne Travel before departure
- Note reason if cap cannot be met

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

Work performed outside the home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside the home country.

IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

Employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country and must hold the right to work in the destination country for the period requested.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review 21 days ahead
- Obtain director and manager approvals
- Notify IT Security 5 business days prior

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports up to USD 2,500 are approved by the direct manager. For a USD 3,000 report, the director approves with a Finance business partner review.

Next steps:
- Book flights 14 days ahead via MosaicOne Travel
- Submit expense report within 45 days with itemised receipts
- Route USD 3,000 report to director for approval

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption, all completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date, and have 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run. Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock.

Engineering hires clone the relevant repositories, build the codebase or bring up a bench, and land a first small change by the end of the first week.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Enroll in benefits in week one; elections due within 30 days of day 90
- Begin 401(k) contributions from first payroll

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

An early laptop refresh requires direct manager approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment. IT sends a prepaid, tracked shipping label to remote employees before their final day, and onsite employees hand equipment to their local IT desk.

Next steps:
- Contact your manager to approve the refresh.
- IT will schedule the swap at your convenience.
- Return the old device within 5 business days of separation.

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases cover immediate risk to a person: violence or a threat of it, a safety incident with injury, a credible risk of self-harm, sexual misconduct involving physical contact, and any matter where someone must be separated from a situation today. Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours.

Next steps:
- Use case reference to track progress
- Contact People Operations if timeline exceeded
- Request written update if case extends

As a hybrid employee assigned to a hub office, you are expected to work on site at least 3 days each week, with specific days set by your team rather than individually.

Hybrid employees have a permanent desk or bookable seat in their assigned office and are included in the office's holiday calendar.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with Dana
- Review MosaicOne for your office assignment details
- Check core collaboration hours for your timezone

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Requests longer than 15 consecutive business days additionally require director approval. Requests that overlap a declared blackout period require director approval regardless of length.

Recommendation — not company policy: As of 2026-09-01, you have 13.5 remaining PTO days. Your accrual rate is 1.5 days per month. Blackout dates are 2026-12-22 and 2026-12-23.

Next steps:
- Submit requests 5 business days ahead for short absences
- Use 15 business days notice for 6+ consecutive days
- Check blackout dates before requesting time

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month. Your accrued balance as of 2026-09-01 is 13.5 days with 0.0 days used year-to-date, leaving 13.5 remaining days.

Every PTO request requires written approval from the employee's direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat and an email thread are all insufficient on their own.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the employee's direct manager.

Recommendation — not company policy: You have sufficient balance and the notice window is met if you submit by end of business Friday 6 September. Submit your request in MosaicOne so your manager Dana can approve it in writing.

Next steps:
- Submit request in MosaicOne by Friday 6 September
- Obtain written manager approval from Dana
- Confirm approval before taking time off

A stay of 30 consecutive days or fewer in an approved country requires manager approval under the Remote & Hybrid Work Policy and nothing further from Tax & Legal.

Ireland is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay from 1 October to 20 October 2026 is 20 consecutive calendar days, which falls within the 30-day threshold.

Recommendation — not company policy: You still must obtain written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure, notify IT Security of the destination at least 5 business days before travel, and use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN.

Next steps:
- Raise the request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates and workspace address.
- Confirm your travel laptop meets device and connectivity requirements with IT Security.

You have completed 45 months of continuous service as of 2026-09-01, exceeding the 12-month minimum required to work outside your home country.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay of 42 consecutive days (3 November to 14 December) exceeds the 30-day threshold and requires director approval and a Tax & Legal review filed at least 21 calendar days before departure.

Tax & Legal review typically approves stays over 30 days with conditions: a hard end date and a prohibition on customer-facing activity.

The 42 days count against your rolling 90-day annual limit for work outside your home country.

Recommendation — not company policy: Notify IT Security of your Berlin destination at least 5 business days before departure so conditional-access rules can be adjusted.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates and workspace address, and file the Tax & Legal review request immediately to meet the 21-calendar-day lead time.

Next steps:
- File manager and director approval plus Tax & Legal review in MosaicOne now.
- Confirm your laptop meets encryption and VPN requirements with IT Security.
- Contact mobility@mosaicrobotics.example with any questions.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits. An employee who makes no election within that window is enrolled in employee-only coverage on the standard medical plan by default.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your waiting period ends on 2026-11-13 (as of 2026-09-01). You should make your benefits elections during the open enrollment window from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-21 so they are in place when your coverage begins.

Next steps:
- Review plan options in MosaicOne before 2026-11-21
- Contact benefits@mosaicrobotics.example with questions
- Confirm elections are submitted by deadline
